key.answer_key: No. The fitted gel Mo 3d components do not pair into the expected 3.1 eV spin-orbit doublets; instead the fitted peaks sit about 1.6 eV and about 6.8 eV apart. The peak at 235.3 eV falls at the binding energy of Mo6+ 3d3/2, not at a signature that confirms the C-S-Mo crosslink assignment (o14).
key.grading: Answer key: the audit ruling on the panel, node o14 (graded target), verified against the fitted binding-energy values and doublet spacing given in that node.
